scenes.title: What is a Diode-Connected MOSFET?
scenes.narration: In CMOS, a diode-connected MOSFET is created by shorting the gate and drain. It acts like a two-terminal resistor in small-signal analysis.

scenes.title: Small-Signal Impedance
scenes.narration: The small-signal impedance is approximately one over the transconductance, gm. Adding the body effect lowers this impedance further to one over the sum of gm and gmb.

visual.formula_where: gm: transconductance; gmb: body effect transconductance

scenes.title: Design Trade-offs
scenes.narration: While useful, diode-connected loads consume voltage headroom, creating a direct trade-off between output voltage swing, gain, and input range in amplifier circuits.
